verdict.rationale: The only concrete recurring-schedule evidence is that RSS campaigns 'send according to its schedule' via the Marketing API (docs-5). Beyond that, the pack mentions 'automations' and 'Enhanced automations' only in marketing copy, with no detail on scheduling. A community user had to treat a monthly subscriber export as something to automate themselves (comm-13), which suggests general recurring jobs are not built in. missing for 10: documented general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling (cron-style or API-driven), detail on automation triggers and schedules beyond RSS campaigns, and independent hands-on corroboration.
